owasp_top_10_focus: A08 Software and Data Integrity Failures
A09 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures

guidance.injection: Use parameterized queries and strict input validation.
guidance.csrf: Use anti-CSRF tokens and SameSite cookies.
guidance.ssrf: Enforce egress allowlists and URL parser hardening.
guidance.headers: Set CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, and Frame-Ancestors/X-Frame-Options.
